title: Beta Features
description: Validates that add-on content does not use beta features flags. The 'use_beta_features' property is not allowed in entity, block, or item behavior definitions for published content. This validator scans manifest files and custom definition JSON files to detect usage of beta feature flags.

101.title: File Read Error
101.description: The validator was unable to read the file contents. This may indicate a corrupted file, encoding issues, or file system permissions problems. Ensure the file is accessible and properly formatted.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the file path that could not be read

102.title: JSON Parse Error
102.description: The file contains invalid JSON syntax and could not be parsed. Check for missing commas, unquoted strings, trailing commas, or other JSON syntax errors. Use a JSON validator to identify the exact location of the error.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the JSON parse error message

103.title: Beta Features Flag
103.description: The 'use_beta_features: true' property was found in an entity, block, or item behavior definition. Beta features are experimental and not allowed in published add-on content. Remove the 'use_beta_features' property or set it to false.
103.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the file path where beta features flag was found
